whoItsFor: Developers using AI coding agents such as Claude Code or Codex on macOS who need the agent to point at buttons, windows, or screen coordinates for a human to act on. It also suits anyone who wants to show someone else how to do something on their Mac.
useCases: Pointing a human at a permission dialog's Allow button instead of leaving the agent to print instructions
Walking someone through a multi-step how-to, such as a Keynote or Finder task
Highlighting the right window or browser tab for demos, screen recordings, or PNG docs
